    Trump Argues Against Global Regulation of AI
    “Americans invented super intelligence.” President Donald Trump has warned that any “robust” regulation of AI, or super intelligence as he terms it, would “stifle” development — even as the US imposes new restrictions on access to advanced AI technology. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Anthropic Raises $107.3 Billion in Watershed AI Debut
    Anthropic and its seven co-founders raised a record $107.3 billion in an upsized IPO and private placement, becoming the first frontier AI lab to tap public markets for the development of thinking machines. The debut marks a watershed moment for both AI and global financial markets that have become increasingly tied to the technology’s prospects. Bloomberg's Ruhell Amin has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)
    BitGo Sees Institutional Crypto Adoption Accelerating
    Angela Ang, BitGo’s APAC managing director, says greater regulatory clarity is driving institutional interest in digital assets as the company expands across Asia-Pacific. She spoke exclusively with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of the Singapore Fintech Festival. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Meta Looks to Hire New India Policy Chief to Repair Frayed Ties
    Meta Platforms Inc. is scouting for a senior public policy executive in India to mend its fractured relationship with the government of one of its biggest growth markets.
    Ripple’s Garlinghouse Sees Crypto Assets Diverging
    Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse expects crypto assets to increasingly diverge in performance, with utility and real demand separating winners from more speculative tokens. He remains bullish on the industry despite a difficult year for the broader crypto market. He speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of 'Singapore Fintech Festival 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Lores Says AI Commerce Is an Opportunity for PayPal
    PayPal President & CEO Enrique Lores says the shift toward AI-driven, agentic commerce is an 'incredible opportunity' for the company, with trust, security and identity becoming increasingly important. He also discusses PayPal’s turnaround, expansion into financial services and investment in AI. Lores speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of 'Singapore Fintech Festival 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)

    South Korea’s financial watchdog has asked major domestic firms to disclose their exposure to the artificial intelligence industry as worries grow over a sector that’s spurred massive investments and debt financing.
